selection.method: Python random.Random(4808) over 2022-01-01..2026-06-20 seven-day windows; exclude starts within 35 days of every previously opened candidate-04 week and keep new starts at least 45 days apart.

staging_contract: Open v8-week-1 only after the v8 source/config/tests are frozen. Open v8-week-2 only if v8-week-1 passes every gate unchanged. Open v8-week-3 only if v8-week-2 also passes. Start no long evaluation unless all three pass unchanged.
